scene.provenance: Original first-person seated desk scene authored in DeskScene.tsx, DeskMonitor.tsx, DeskKeyboard.tsx, DeskAccessories.tsx, DeskPlants.tsx, and DeskAtmosphere.tsx, with local camera and screen-projection code. Procedural ultrawide curved monitor, wood desk, ivory/sage mechanical keyboard, mouse, coffee, plants, and lamp; no human or chair geometry. Surface, contact-shadow, and studio-reflection textures are generated deterministically in memory. User-supplied Odyssey G8 photographs inform the monitor silhouette only; no Samsung logo or promotional image is reproduced and no affiliation is implied. https://github.com/Developer-Square/Threejs-Keyboard and https://keyboardsimulator.xyz/ are visual keyboard references. https://github.com/GlintonLiao/questopia is a visual quality benchmark only. All shipped geometry and artwork are newly authored, with no reference code or assets reused. No imported model, external textures, animation clips, or recordings.

supporting_assets.provenance: Neutral monitor symbol authored as SVG in this project; a placeholder interface mark, not a finalized brand.

Original static SVG illustration of the same first-person desk for loading and unavailable WebGL. An empty dark ultrawide screen supports the projected interface; the scene contains no person, chair, external image, or third-party logo.
